rationale: Record a test-registration change that crosses design-source-ingest through test/cmake/design_import_native_codegen_tests.cmake: a pulp_test_data(pulp-test-design-import-native-materializer NO_DEFINE ...) declaration of the include roots its generated-source compiles read, one fader image and one music header. The materializer test's compile helper drops the repository root from its include directories and refuses a compile whose dependency file reaches a checkout file outside those roots; every existing generated-source compile passes unchanged. Codegen, capture, rendering, DesignIR, fixtures and thresholds are unchanged, and all build.ninja DEFINES/FLAGS lines are identical apart from configure-time stamps. Registered as watch-only so family coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
